name: Differentiable Volume Rendering via Box Splines
aliases: Differentiable X-ray Transform with Ray-Trace Gradients
definition: A differentiable volume rendering method using box spline interpolation to compute gradients of the projection integral with respect to ray parameters (origin $t$ and direction $n$) and volume data. It handles 2D and 3D uniform grids, supporting interpolation orders 0, 1, and 2.
summary: This method computes differentiable X-ray transforms using box spline interpolation to provide exact gradients for ray parameters and volume coefficients without finite differences.
